channel.title: Natural Sciences Museum Science Café Events
channel.description: Science Café events from the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences

item.title: Science Trivia (Nov 5, 2026)
item.description: What’s cooler than absolute zero? The answer is Science Trivia night at NCMNS! Questions feature a mix of science facts, current news, pop culture and scientific discoveries. Held in the Daily Planet Cafe the first Thursday of each month, this is a great opportunity to mingle with friends, compete for prizes and bragging rights, and perhaps even learn something cool. The Museum closes at 5 PM; the Daily Planet Cafe will remain open. Please copy the URL below to share this page!

item.title: Science Café: Illuminating AI Night (Apr 16, 2026)
item.description: Curious about what data science and AI bring to your life everyday? Join us for an evening discussing exciting local research from scientists at the NC Museum of Natural Sciences, UNC-Chapel Hill, UNC’s Renaissance Computing Institute (RENCI), NC State University, and beyond! You’ll learn about exciting research using artificial intelligence and data science methods to spark charismatic animal research, health-related research, participatory science opportunities in your backyard and across the ...

item.title: Teen Science Café: How does Robotic Surgery Work? (Mar 6, 2026)
item.description: This program is recommended for participants ages 11–17. Cafés will be held in person at the Daily Planet Cafe AND streamed live on YouTube. Registration is required for online participation. Please copy the URL below to share this page!

item.title: Teen Science Café (Apr 10, 2026)
item.description: Teen Science Cafés bring teens together in an informal setting to learn about science and technology. Cafés happen from 6pm to 7pm the first Friday of each month during the school year. Each café will include a scientist presentation, an interactive activity relating to the discussion, a Q&A session, and time to socialize with other teens who enjoy science. This program is recommended for participants ages 11–17. Cafés will be held in person at the Daily Planet Cafe AND streamed live on YouTube....
